title: Process-Knowledge-Guided Latent Diffusion for Generative Design of Porous Architectures: A Case Study in Aerosol Jet Printing
abstract: arXiv:2611.25264v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Printed porous layouts interleave functional material with open channels, and the layout that uses the material best depends on how the process settings shape the deposit. Generative models propose layouts quickly, but a generator that does not receive the process setting samples from the same distribution at every setting, even when the process-dependent score ranks candidate layouts differently. This paper examines whether process knowledge can steer a latent diffusion generator toward layouts suited to a given process setting in a prescribed design domain. We formulate a process-dependent utilization score in which a process model sets the length over which the utility of printed material decays with distance from a channel. The generator combines a vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE) latent representation, a topology U-Net, a ControlNet domain branch, and a separately trained regressor that predicts the score from noise

translated_title: 工艺知识引导的潜在扩散模型用于多孔结构的生成式设计：以气溶胶喷射打印为例
translated_abstract: 印刷多孔布局将功能性材料与开放通道相互交织，而材料利用率最优的布局取决于工艺设置如何塑造沉积形态。生成模型能够快速提出布局方案，但若生成器在每种工艺设置下接收的样本并非来自同一分布，即使工艺相关评分对候选布局的排序存在差异，其结果也会受到影响。本文探讨了工艺知识能否引导潜在扩散生成器，在给定设计域内生成适合特定工艺设置的布局。我们构建了一个依赖工艺的利用率评分，其中工艺模型确定了印刷材料的效用随距通道距离而衰减的长度尺度。该生成器融合了向量量化变分自编码器（VQ-VAE）潜在表示、拓扑U-Net、ControlNet域分支，以及一个单独训练的、可根据噪声预测评分的回归器。
tldr: 该论文提出一种工艺知识引导的潜在扩散生成框架，将基于工艺模型的利用率评分与VQ-VAE潜在表示、拓扑U-Net和ControlNet分支相结合，使生成的多孔结构布局能够适配特定的气溶胶喷射打印工艺设置。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a process-knowledge-guided latent diffusion generator that integrates a process-model-based utilization score with VQ-VAE latent representations, a topology U-Net, and a ControlNet branch to produce porous architectures tailored to specific aerosol jet printing process settings.
